domain.text: vmethod CLI and gateway development, focused on GitHub board handoffs and watcher behavior.

impressions.text: The change addressed false “In review with no assignee” alerts by ordering assignment before the status handoff and adding a watcher grace period for recent writes.
The orchestrator caught that an existing test fake did not handle the new write order; the worker updated it and added a regression test for a poll during handoff.
The worker reported blocked status while CI appeared red; the orchestrator later attributed the repeated failure to a stale-verdict bug and reported current-head CI green.
The orchestrator graded the merged delivery at 0.5 estimate and $0.106170.
